{{Quote|Well, well, well, the valiant ''FarStar'' crew again. This time, I'd like to introduce you to some friends of mine!|Mist|<ref name="S">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Showdown (The Kathol Rift)|book=The Kathol Rift}}''</ref>}}
'''Mist''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operating during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Born '''Shella Inion''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], she was a minor [[Actor/Legends|actress]] who disappeared from public view after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her family and her own partial disfigurement following a suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Attack on Shella Inion's hometown|attack]] on her [[Shella Inion's hometown|hometown]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] controlling Kal'Shebbol, had planned and staged the attack to further his own agenda, and to reduce popular support for the Rebel Alliance. Inion reinvented herself as the bounty hunter known only as Mist, utilizing a highly modified suit of [[Krail Armory]]'s [[Model 1010 Photo-reactive Personal Armor]] to disguise both her appearance and gender.

Mist was regarded as a capable individual, and she allied herself with Moff Sarne, blaming the Rebellion for the death of her family. When the planet Kal'Shebbol was [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|taken]] by the New Republic in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Mist was off-planet on an assignment, and was subsequently separated from Sarne. The Moff managed to escape his [[Capital/Legends|capital]] with the bulk of his [[Moff Sarne's forces|fleet]], and Mist spent several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] trying to regroup with him and his forces, tracking his movements through the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] and the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. Eventually succeeding, she led several military missions that encountered the crew of the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', which was on a [[DarkStryder Campaign|mission]] to locate Sarne.

Mist traveled with Sarne to the planet [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]], and defended him throughout the [[Battle of DarkStryder's Fortress]], escaping with him to the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[launch gate]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the planet. Sarne planned to activate the launch gate and destroy the New Republic forces [[Battle of Kathol System|battling]] his own ships in orbit of the planet as part of his plan to reconquer the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Wounded during the engagement, Mist was captured by members of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew. [[Jessa Dajus]], a member of the ''FarStar'' crew and a former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in Sarne's Imperial regime, told her that the attack that had claimed the lives of her family had actually been planned and staged by the Moff to incriminate the Rebels. Enraged at having been lied to, Mist switched her allegiances and assisted the crew of the ''FarStar'' in defeating Sarne.

==Biography==
===Early life===
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Shella Inion was a minor [[Actor/Legends|actress]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]].<ref name="E" /> Some [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="CSWE-Mist">{{CSWECite|II|319|Mist}}</ref> she disappeared from public view after she was facially scarred and her family was killed in a supposed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Attack on Shella Inion's hometown|attack]]<ref name="E" /> on her [[Shella Inion's hometown|hometown]].<ref name="CSWE-Inion">{{CSWECite|II|103|Inion, Shella}}</ref> The attack had actually been planned and staged on the orders of [[Kentor Sarne]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] ruling the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], as a way of eroding popular support for the Rebellion. Reinventing herself as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as "Mist,"<ref name="E" /> she began plying her trade shortly before the Imperial defeat at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="CSWE-Mist" /> and soon became an enigmatic figure in the Kathol sector's criminal underworld. Her new persona hid the details of her former life and, due to the heavily modified [[Model 1010 Photo-reactive Personal Armor|personal armor]] she wore, many were convinced that "Mist" was actually a male. Believing in Sarne's propaganda that Rebels had been responsible for the attack that had killed her loved ones, she threw in her lot with the Moff, acting as his personal enforcer.<ref name="E" />

===Bounty hunting===
Mist built up an impressive and violent reputation throughout the underworld of the Kathol sector, and seldom appeared in public throughout Moff Sarne's reign,<ref name="KO" /> who had subsequently taken over the sector as an independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] following the fragmentation of [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial command authority]] following the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at Endor.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> She worked almost exclusively for the Imperial warlord, and enjoyed the work. The [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] was good and the jobs were challenging and interesting.<ref name="GE">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Galaxy's Edge|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Mist was off-planet on assignment for Sarne when Kal'Shebbol [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|fell]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Left behind in Sarne's retreat from the sector, Mist began searching for the Moff, tracking down clues from her Imperial sources. While searching for Sarne's location, she returned to traditional bounty hunting activities. Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the Battle of Kal'Shebbol, Mist was on the planet [[Danoor]]. While in the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eror Zeen]], she assisted the crew of the New Republic [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[FarStar]]'', dealing with two government [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that had tried to kill a [[Mission group|landing party]] that was searching for the navigator, [[Makezh]].<ref name="GE" />

===In the service of Moff Sarne===
{{Quote|Intruders! Troopers to ready position!|Mist on the [[alien construct]]|<ref name="W">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Waystation|book=The Kathol Rift}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mistattack.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mist attacks members of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew.]]
Following her adventure on Danoor, Mist managed to regroup with Sarne's forces. Mist was put in command of a [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] with a complement of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|spacetroopers]]. While investigating a strange [[alien construct]] within the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]&mdash;a volatile area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] filled with dense [[Nebula/Legends|nebulaic]] material and [[lightstorm]]s&mdash;the assault [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was captured by docking tendrils from the station and drawn into one of its docking domes. Trapped on the construct, Mist and the stormtroopers explored the alien station and discovered how to release their ship by finding the override controls that managed the docking tendrils.<ref name="W" /> During her exploration of the construct, she discovered a piece of [[DarkStryder technology]],<ref name="CSWE-Mist" /> an artifact that created a [[DarkStryder fire creature|fire creature]]. Just before they were due to leave, one of the stormtrooper patrols encountered a boarding party from the ''FarStar''. The New Republic ship was being ensnared just as Mist's assault shuttle had been, and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''FarStar'', had sent a mission to the station to free the ship.<ref name="W" />

This time, however, Mist was not interested in assisting them, and ordered the stormtroopers under her command to fire on the New Republic crew members once they had reached the docking dome where her shuttle was being held. During the [[Skirmish on the Alien Construct|firefight]], Mist used her [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to gain altitude and a tactical advantage, then unleashed the fire creature within the DarkStryder artifact. Controlled by a device on her [[Armor/Legends|armor]], Mist had the creature clear a path to her ship and she prepared to escape. Mist intended for the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew to be in the docking dome when she depressurized it to leave, killing them in the process, but they managed to escape in time. Successfully launching from the construct, Mist briefly engaged the ''FarStar'' with the ''Gamma''-class assault shuttle while waiting for a [[Precision hyperspace jump|micro-jump]] to be plotted. During the brief engagement, she launched four spacetroopers to deal with the ''FarStar'', but left them behind once the shuttle was able to jump.<ref name="W" />

[[File:Mistcamo.jpg|thumb|right|Mist engages her armor's camouflage.]]
Several weeks later, Mist led a unit of stormtroopers, backed by an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and an [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]], in setting up an ambush for the ''FarStar'' on the planet [[Demonsgate]] on the edge of the Kathol Rift. Posing as a downed Imperial survey mission unable to rendezvous with Sarne, they sent out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] that the ''FarStar'' intercepted. A mission was organized, but before it was launched, the ''FarStar''{{'s}} navigator, Makezh, stole an [[Codex|artifact]] that the crew had recovered on the alien construct, and fled to the planet. The mission intended to investigate the Imperial signal was re-tasked to recover Makezh and the Codex, and they tracked him to a [[Geyser/Legends|geyser]] field on the surface. There, Mist and the Imperial forces ambushed them, taking Makezh prisoner. Mist ordered the ''FarStar'' crewmembers to surrender or she would kill Makezh. The navigator unexpectedly erupted into action, knocking Mist to the ground and running off. Hitting the ground, Mist ordered the stormtroopers to open fire. The ensuing [[Skirmish on Demonsgate|battle]] favored the Imperial forces, but they were attacked in turn by the mysterious [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] monks since they had threatened Makezh. Makezh was carrying their sacred artifact, the Codex, which he had been preprogrammed to retrieve for them. The Aing-Tii abducted the Imperial soldiers, but Mist escaped their clutches.<ref name="S" />

Mist left Demonsgate and rendezvoused with Sarne's forces, accompanying them to [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. During the [[Battle of DarkStryder's Fortress]], Mist remained with Sarne, and escaped the battle with him to the orbiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[launch gate]]. The launch gate was an ancient piece of technology created by the extinct [[Kathol (species)|Kathol]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to propel their spacecraft into hyperspace. Sarne planned to use the launch gate to destroy the New Republic forces arrayed against him in one fell swoop, believing that this would allow him to reconquer the sector and retake his capital of Kal'Shebbol. On the launch gate, Mist was wounded by members of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew who had followed them while she was defending Sarne, and was subsequently captured. Unmasked and recognized by [[Jessa Dajus]], a member of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew and a former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who had served under Moff Sarne, she was told the truth about the attack that had killed her family&mdash;an attack that Dajus herself had helped to plan. Aware of the truth, and that Sarne had lied to her, Mist switched her allegiance and assisted the ''FarStar'' crew in stopping Sarne.<ref name="E" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Throw down your weapons and surrender, or I'll kill your crewmate.|Mist to the ''[[FarStar]]'' crew while threatening [[Makezh]]|<ref name="S" />}}
Mist had sharp features, curly [[Color/Legends|blonde]] hair, and a scar on the left side of her face. She spoke infrequently, usually in clipped and curt phrases. Her female voice was disguised by the voice amplification system built into her armor's helmet. Mist maintained a hatred of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and its successor, the New Republic, believing that they were responsible for both the deaths of her family, and her own facial scarring.<ref name="KO" /> However, this hatred was only directed at them because she believed in Sarne's propaganda surrounding the incident. Once she learned the truth, that Sarne had planned and authorized the attack himself, she turned her anger towards Sarne and even allied herself with the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew during their assault on the Moff on the hyperspace launch gate.<ref name="E" />

Mist was considered to be both capable and violent.<ref name="KO" /> An accomplished warrior, she was trained to use blasters, [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] and [[Missile/Legends|missile]] weapons, and was skilled in [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee combat]]. Mist showed battlefield prowess and tactical command abilities against the ''FarStar'' crew on several occasions,<ref name="W" /> and even managed to escape from the clutches of the Aing-Tii on Demonsgate.<ref name="S" /> Mist was also practical and callous, and would not hesitate in spending troopers' lives to achieve her goal. During a skirmish with the ''FarStar'' above the alien construct, she ordered spacetroopers into battle despite knowing that they would be left behind once a micro-jump had been plotted.<ref name="W" />

==Skills and abilities==
As a bounty hunter, Mist had survival talents, and was able to track targets. She also had knowledge of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species, other languages and [[Star system/Legends|planetary systems]], and [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]]. Mist was qualified to fly space [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Astrogation/Legends|navigate]] through hyperspace, and could also operate [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles. She was also trained to use a starship's weapons and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] systems, and had a working knowledge of security equipment. Encased in body armor while working as a bounty hunter, Mist was proficient in the use of jet packs and [[Power armor/Legends|powersuits]], and was able to repair her own armor and weapons.<ref name="KO" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Mist.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Mist's armor]]

===Weapons===
Mist carried a veritable arsenal of weapons to allow her to pursue both her trade as a bounty hunter, and as Moff Sarne's personal enforcer. Her primary weapons included a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], and a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] mounted with a [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonet]] blade, along with a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] for emergencies. Mist also carried two [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke grenades]] and two [[paralysis grenade]]s,<ref name="KO" /> and also utilized a DarkStryder artifact that released a fire creature<ref name="W" /> that she discovered while on the alien construct within the Kathol Rift.<ref name="CSWE-Mist" /> As a licensed bounty hunter, Mist was required to carry an [[Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate/Legends|Imperial Peace Keeping Certificate]], and carried [[Binders/Legends|binders]] and a [[Reversed repulsorfield|man trap]] to deal with live captures.<ref name="KO" />

===Armor===
Mist wore a heavily modified suit of [[Krail Armory]] Model 1010 Photo-reactive Personal Armor. Bulky and intimidating in appearance, the armor served to disguise Mist's gender, and she was often mistaken for a man. The suit was covered in a coating of [[Photo-reactive coating|photosensitive microscopic crystal]]s that reflected the ambient colors of any area, making the armor difficult to see. Combined with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]-absorbing [[Reflec/Legends|reflec plating]], Mist's armor was virtually undetectable and gave her an edge over most opponents. The armor also boasted a sealed [[enviro filter]] with a three-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] supply of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. The filter contained a [[voice disguiser]] that made Mist's voice impossible to identify as female. Mist had also incorporated a jetpack into her armor, and an integral [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launcher]]. The suit offered basic protection to Mist from weapons fire and melee attacks. An integrated sensor package gave Mist enhanced senses, and the suit also augmented her strength.<ref name="KO" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Artof-01.jpg|thumb|right|Concept art of Boba Fett's armor.]]
The character of Mist was created by [[West End Games]] for ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and part of [[The DarkStryder Campaign (series)|''The DarkStryder Campaign'']]. In the notes for the gamemaster, it was suggested that the bounty hunter was to be encountered by the player characters on several occasions, but observed from a distance to preserve the mystery of the character since they would play an important part in future DarkStryder adventures. Mist was a minor antagonist in ''[[The Kathol Rift]]'', directly confronting the player characters, while her true name and background was revealed in the final book of the DarkStryder series, ''[[Endgame]]''. Mist earned two entries in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' under both her true name, and her assumed identity.

Mist's helmet appears to be based on an early concept design for [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Concept art published on page 145 of ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' shows several different helmet designs by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] and [[Joe Johnston]]. The image on the right hand side of the top row shows a helmet similar in appearance to Mist's, including the pronounced visor and helmet mounted antenna.
